name: Dynamic Assist Companion
brief: Lets the Dynamic Assist browser extension query any table you can read, read-only.
description: The companion to the Dynamic Assist browser extension. Its Dynamic Assist Query page lets the extension's query builder list tables and fields and run read-only queries (filters, related tables, FlowFields, sort, row limit) as the signed-in user, and its read-only REST endpoints offer the same queries and Dataverse couplings to other tools. Your permissions and security filters apply; it writes nothing but its own query log.
